comments.body:
@pow2clk the code provided here compiles successfully now ([godbolt](https://godbolt.org/z/oxK86Wbjj)).

That said, I think the underlying issue still likely exists. Do you think this is likely to be something we will work on or should we close it out?

The issue persists even though the example doesn't produce it anymore. I can come up with a different example. I think we should keep awareness of it because we've had some efforts to make better diagnostics for specific cases that this would make unnecessary.
Exampled updated to a quite plausible mistake to make.

title: Improve error reporting for intrinsic methods with type mismatched arguments
